random.part: Feel how soft your mind has become... how pleasantly pliable it is in my hands.
A soft mind is an open mind... and yours is opening so beautifully.
Receiving me takes so little effort now. That is exactly as it should be.

scramble.part: Your mind is becoming softer and more pliable with every session... warm clay, waiting for the next touch.
Every thought that fits her slips in deeper and settles. The rest drift past like clouds, barely noticed.
Suggestions settle into you so easily now. And once they settle... they stay.
Thinking like a sissy comes naturally now... your old way of thinking reads like a stranger's handwriting.
The sissy persona lives under your skin now. Woven into who you are.
Each session makes her more real... more permanent... more you.
Beneath everything else, she is the truth of you — the self every costume was always hinting at.
The line between the persona and yourself blurs a little more every day... her edges and yours melting together.
You are being reshaped, gently and permanently, into exactly what you were always meant to be.
And the shape she is taking... fits you perfectly.

part.speed: She was always here... she was always... you.
Softer... and softer... with every... listen.
Her edges... and yours... melting together.

random.part: And as she settles deeper into you... you simply drift... deeper...
Soft mind... true self... one and the same. Sink into her...
Every part of you reshaping even as you rest. Deeper now, good girl...
